coverage_query:
SELECT clock_timestamp() observed_at,to_jsonb(r) readiness,
(SELECT jsonb_object_agg(status,n) FROM(SELECT status,count(*) n FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task t WHERE t.family_id=r.family_id GROUP BY status)x) native_status_counts,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('stage',stage,'status',status,'tasks',n) ORDER BY stage,status) FROM(SELECT stage,status,count(*) n FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task t WHERE t.family_id=r.family_id GROUP BY stage,status)x) native_stages,
(SELECT to_jsonb(v)-'evidence' FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_validation v WHERE v.family_id=r.family_id ORDER BY verified_at DESC LIMIT 1) latest_partition_validation,
(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('blocker',blocker_code,'tasks',n) ORDER BY n DESC) FROM(SELECT blocker_code,count(*) n FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_task t WHERE t.family_id=r.family_id AND status='BLOCKED' GROUP BY blocker_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 5)x) top_native_blockers
FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_family_readiness_v1 r ORDER BY family_id;

daily_review.review_sql:
WITH computed AS MATERIALIZED(WITH corrections AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_d02_adig_corroborated_points_v1
 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.working_d02_sec_corroborated_points_v1),
affected AS MATERIALIZED(
 SELECT v.* FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.ctx06_observed_vote_v4 v
 WHERE run_key='a8b5b252d10b2a64bbe768ac7e9a51b013ecffa5600a948e3a86fa6b67598ba3'
 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM corrections c WHERE c.dated_point_and_source_link_verified IS TRUE AND c.company_id=v.company_id AND c.session_date IN(v.session_date,v.previous_session_date))),
paired AS (
 SELECT v.*,to_jsonb(cur) current_correction,to_jsonb(prev) previous_correction,cur.raw_close c,prev.raw_close p,
 cur.ticker current_ticker,prev.ticker previous_ticker,
 CASE WHEN cur.company_id IS NULL OR prev.company_id IS NULL THEN 'MISSING_TWO_CORROBORATED_DATE_POINTS'
 WHEN cur.ticker IS DISTINCT FROM prev.ticker THEN 'TICKER_TRANSITION_REQUIRES_INSTRUMENT_ACTION_QUALIFICATION'
 WHEN cur.raw_close IS NULL OR prev.raw_close IS NULL OR cur.raw_close<=0 OR prev.raw_close<=0 OR cur.raw_close::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') OR prev.raw_close::text IN('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity') THEN 'INVALID_CLOSE_PAIR'
 ELSE NULL END hold
 FROM affected v LEFT JOIN corrections cur ON cur.company_id=v.company_id AND cur.session_date=v.session_date AND cur.dated_point_and_source_link_verified IS TRUE
 LEFT JOIN corrections prev ON prev.company_id=v.company_id AND prev.session_date=v.previous_session_date AND prev.dated_point_and_source_link_verified IS TRUE)
SELECT jsonb_build_object('company_id',company_id,'company_ordinal',company_ordinal,'original_vote_ticker',ticker,'anchor_ticker',coalesce(current_correction->>'anchor_ticker',previous_correction->>'anchor_ticker'),'session_date',session_date,'previous_session_date',previous_session_date,'original_vote_sha256',record_sha256,'original_return_1d',return_1d::text,'original_missing_reason',missing_reason,'current_correction',current_correction,'previous_correction',previous_correction,'current_close',c::text,'previous_close',p::text,'raw_close_proxy_return',CASE WHEN hold IS NULL THEN (c/p-1)::text ELSE NULL END,'holding_reason',hold,'formula','current retained unadjusted close / previous retained unadjusted close - 1','definition','CORROBORATED_DATE_POINT_RAW_CLOSE_PROXY_NOT_ADJUSTMENT_QUALIFIED_RETURN','old_vote_mutated',false,'company_representative_qualified',false,'regular_session_basis_verified',false,'corporate_action_qualified',false,'strict_point_in_time_qualified',false,'historical_receipt_proven',false,'independent_economic_accuracy_verified',false,'family_accepted',false) record FROM paired ORDER BY session_date,company_ordinal),stored AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT r FROM population_top3000_202608_202609_v1.pipeline_event e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(details->'rows') r WHERE event_id=86479) SELECT clock_timestamp() checked_at,count(*) cells,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.record IS DISTINCT FROM s.r) row_errors,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.record->>'raw_close_proxy_return' IS NOT NULL) raw_proxies,count(*) FILTER(WHERE c.record->>'holding_reason' IS NOT NULL) held FROM computed c FULL JOIN stored s ON c.record->>'company_id'=s.r->>'company_id' AND c.record->>'session_date'=s.r->>'session_date';
